record.paper_title: Exchange Bias and Interface-related Effects in Two-dimensional van der Waals Magnetic Heterostructures: Open Questions and Perspectives
record.original_question: Can an intermediate magnetically disordered interfacial phase form at a ferromagnet/antiferromagnet van der Waals interface, and if so, can that disordered phase itself induce exchange bias?

evidence.quote: vi. Can an intermediate magnetically disordered phase be formed at the FM/AFM interface and induce the EB effect in FM/AFM vdW systems?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider a two-dimensional van der Waals heterostructure consisting of a ferromagnetic (FM) layer stacked on an antiferromagnetic (AFM) layer, modeled by a layered Heisenberg-type spin Hamiltonian in which interlayer exchange couplings across the interface may be inhomogeneous (frustrated, defective, or randomly signed). The exchange bias (EB) effect is the horizontal shift H_E of the field-cooled hysteresis loop M(H) of the FM layer, attributed to pinned uncompensated moments at the FM/AFM interface.

Define an "intermediate magnetically disordered interfacial phase" as a region of finite thickness adjacent to the geometric FM/AFM interface in which the local spin order parameter is neither purely ferromagnetic nor purely Néel-antiferromagnetic, but instead exhibits spin-glass-like or short-range-ordered behavior (e.g., nonzero Edwards–Anderson order parameter with vanishing magnetization and vanishing staggered magnetization on the relevant length scale).

Question: Within such a model (or any physically faithful microscopic/continuum description of 2D van der Waals FM/AFM bilayers):
(a) Can an intermediate magnetically disordered interfacial phase emerge as a stable (or metastable, field-cooled) phase at the FM/AFM interface?
(b) If such a disordered interfacial phase exists, can it by itself produce a nonzero exchange bias field H_E ≠ 0 in the FM layer's hysteresis loop, independently of any long-range AFM order in the bulk of the antiferromagnetic layer?

Provide either a construction/proof of existence and a derivation of H_E from the disordered phase, or a no-go argument ruling it out.
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as an open perspective question about 2D van der Waals FM/AFM heterostructures. While disordered interfacial phases and their role in inducing exchange bias have been discussed in conventional (non-vdW) systems, no definitive resolution specifically for vdW FM/AFM interfaces has been established in the recent literature. The status appears open.

status_evidence.title: Exchange Bias and Interface-related Effects in 2D vdW Magnetic Heterostructures
status_evidence.snippet: Open questions including whether an intermediate magnetically disordered interfacial phase can form and induce EB in FM/AFM vdW systems.
status_evidence.claim: Listed as an open question/perspective in a recent review of the field.
